name: antrop-personas
description: Antrop's qualitative-research pipeline for behavioural personas — from raw interview to brand-designed deliverable. Ten checkpoint-gated skills (clean, analyse, frame-and-cluster, generate, compare-baseline, validate, design, polish-language, package, interview-cards) that keep the analyst as the decision-maker and Claude as the heavy-lifter. Eight required steps + two opt-in side-branches. Tuned for Opus 4.8 (xhigh effort on the quality-critical agents) and Sonnet 4.6 (Swedish polish + card rendering). Built from Naturvårdsverket v1 (2026), with pitfalls baked in as warnings.
